title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Updated to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance, enhancing accessibility for users.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: Increased minSdkVersion to 24, breaking compatibility with devices running older Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its app to support the new minSdkVersion to remain functional.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes and Long Codes to Appalachian Wireless United States
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from a subset of Twilio Short Codes and Long Codes to Appalachian Wireless network subscribers in the United States.
backbase_rationale: Twilio SMS delivery delays are affecting customers on Appalachian Wireless, necessitating immediate resolution.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Iliad Italy
impact_summary: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to Iliad network subscribers in Italy and are monitoring service stability.
backbase_rationale: Twilio SMS delivery failures are impacting customers on Iliad Italy, requiring ongoing monitoring to ensure stability.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The Send to Coworker action in Domain Authentication flow has been removed, simplifying the process and reducing potential DNS errors.
backbase_rationale: Streamline domain authentication by eliminating low-usage paths and improving security.

title: Verify tightens fraud prevention geo permissions for Italy and Argentina
impact_summary: Default geo permissions for Italy and Argentina will automatically change to 'Monitor all traffic for fraud', requiring Fraud Guard for full protection.
backbase_rationale: Ensure compliance with fraud protection regulations.
